name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began as a teenager, spending countless hours tinkering with go-karts at his local club. He quickly developed a knack for understanding the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and race strategy. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he honed his skills as a race engineer for a smaller team, before catching the eye of Triple Eight Race Engineering.

As Sporting Director, Jean-Pierre brings a unique blend of technical expertise and managerial acumen. He's known for his ability to identify and nurture emerging talent within the team, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. His commitment to a holistic approach, considering every facet of the team's performance from the garage to the pit wall, sets him apart. Jean-Pierre believes in empowering his team and providing them with the resources and support to push boundaries and achieve excellence on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build, Jean-Pierre always has a thoughtful expression, as if constantly analyzing data.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten race strategy notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of French roast coffee before every race.
